instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Telemedicine platform connecting patients with GPs and specialists for video consultations, e-prescriptions, and remote monitoring. 500+ credentialed physicians on the platform with 120,000 completed consultations. Regulated as a Class I medical device. Seeking AI-powered triage and symptom checking to optimize specialist routing. The organization has significant capital, talent depth, and existing technology infrastructure, but internal processes are designed for stability and risk management — not speed. Innovation initiatives must navigate procurement, legal, compliance, and IT security review before receiving green-light. The key challenge is not resource availability but organizational velocity.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is not a formalized function in our organization. We occasionally try new tools or workflows when a team member champions them, but these are isolated, grassroots efforts without executive sponsorship, budget allocation, or structured measurement of outcomes.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 4 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Establish Formal Digital Triage/AI Routing Pathway
opportunities.rationale: Forge is seeking AI-powered triage to optimize specialist routing, which represents a clear value stream. Since the organization has significant existing technology and data volume (120k consultations), formalizing this into a structured digital product line is an incremental step that leverages current assets.

first_actions: Establish a cross-functional working group involving IT, Legal/Compliance, Clinical Operations, and Product Management to define scope.
Map existing data flow from initial symptom input through the specialist referral process.
Develop preliminary compliance requirements checklist for AI medical device classification (Class I considerations).
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduced specialist routing time by 15% within the pilot group.
milestones: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for triage implemented in sandbox environment (Q4)
Pilot deployment with one specialty group (Q1 next year)

opportunities.title: Develop New Revenue Stream via Adjacent Care Segments (Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: The company is heavily dependent on its top 3 clients and a single product category. To achieve diversification, the radical effort must explore adjacent care segments or new business models entirely outside current core offerings. This requires leveraging existing infrastructure for non-core services.

first_actions: Conduct market deep dive on potential secondary care markets (e.g., preventative wellness, chronic disease management) not currently served.
Model the financial viability of entering 2-3 diverse customer segments using existing platform capabilities in a white-label or partnership model.
Identify and secure internal subject matter experts from clinical/operational teams for market testing.
execution_plan.success_metric: Formalized go-to-market strategy and initial partnership MOUs with 2 new customer segment types.
milestones: Business case for new revenue stream approved by Board (Next year)

next_steps.action: Formalize the organizational structure to reduce reliance on informal champions and establish a dedicated Innovation Office (IO).
Execute mandatory regulatory gap analysis for all planned new digital features and product lines to ensure compliance at the design stage (shift-left compliance).
Pilot a 'Design Thinking Sprint' approach involving cross-functional teams to rapidly prototype and test hypotheses for new business models identified in the diversification opportunity.

key_weaknesses: Organizational velocity is hampered by overly cautious internal processes (procurement, legal, IT security review).
High concentration risk in the customer base and product lines.
Innovation remains reactive/grassroots rather than strategically sponsored.

improvements: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management, enhancing structural stability.
Strategic planning processes are becoming formalized, providing better direction for future initiatives.
Dedicated senior leadership hired (4 leaders), improving execution capacity.
persistent_gaps: The core process bottlenecks (compliance/legal review) still slow down speed to market.
Lack of a formal, executive-championed innovation function means strategic direction remains siloed or ad hoc.
achieved_milestones: Successfully completed key initial opportunities and steps identified in the previous cycle (e.g., opp_1 status change implies progress).

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant structural improvements noted (professional management, formalized planning). The focus has sharpened from basic process establishment to tackling core strategic risks like revenue concentration and organizational speed.
